meta.name: American Horror Story: Halloween Episodes
meta.description: 4 Halloween episodes of American Horror Story.

videos.title: Halloween (1)
videos.name: Halloween (1)
videos.overview: The line between the living and the dead blurs on Halloween. Two of the house's previous residents give the Harmons decorating advice.

videos.title: Halloween (2)
videos.name: Halloween (2)
videos.overview: While on a date with Violet, Tate is harassed by a group of bloody teens. Ben and Vivien are haunted by one of the house's newest guests.

videos.title: Edward Mordrake (1)
videos.name: Edward Mordrake (1)
videos.overview: The Freaks refuse to perform on Halloween due to an old carny superstition. Jimmy is smitten by a woman claiming to be a fortuneteller. Ethel receives life-changing news.

videos.title: Room Service
videos.name: Room Service
videos.overview: Alex uses an unconventional treatment to save a dying patient. A Halloween-hating couple tests Iriss limits.
